text.card: A red giant 2,241 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 2, give 0.88 solar masses and 10.8 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,636 K at its surface.
